items.title: 11.3 Reaction mechanism and modes of bond breaking (bond tootne ke tareeqe) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.3 with Figures 11.5 and 11.6, printed pages 251-252.

blocks.text: Reaction mechanism un steps (qadmon) ki series (silsila) hai jo poori reaction ke dauran hote hain. Tamam chemical reactions ki tarah organic reactions mein bhi chemical bonds toot-te hain. Covalent bond do tarah se toot sakta hai.
